title: erigeron divergens var. nudiflorus
intro: Erigeron divergens var. nudiflorus, commonly known as Western Daisy Fleabane, is a plant species native to North America, characterized by its daisy-like flowers and medicinal properties. Western Daisy Fleabane has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Western Daisy Fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
